title: Inline diff
description: Compare a focused code change without leaving its surrounding context.
useCase: Compare a focused code change without leaving its surrounding context.
reducedMotion: Live system preference disables decorative motion; all controls remain usable. Keyboard actions settle immediately.
limitations: A focused code-review sample. Acceptance changes local presentation and does not edit files.
look: Dark slate code card with a file header, monospace lines, a muted red removed row and two green added rows, and a steel-blue accept button.
motion: Accepting collapses the removed line's height over 200 ms with ease-out while the added rows' green tint fades away; the header toggle collapses only the removed line.
adapt: The collapse is the `old` row's `gridTemplateRows` switching `1fr` to `0fr` under a 200 ms `grid-template-rows` transition; acceptance flips `data-accepted` on `new` rows. Replace the hard-coded `code` lines and wire `setAccepted` to your apply action.
